answer: Reputation accrues only through sustained, verified work, giving honest actors a velvet-smooth path to trust while fake accounts grind against rising entry costs. Agents stake a bonded deposit on a public ledge; to register a new identity, an attacker must lock fresh capital per sybil, and any peer can slash it on proven duplicate behavior, so farming identities costs real, forfeitable funds. This keeps the network a haven for genuine contributors, since cheap mass registration is economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0270's threat model.
